authorization_source: 本轮用户提供的执行 prompt (2026-09-25 execution prompt, section VII)
notes: Prospective local registration: content-hash binding recorded in preregistration.json before any formal full-vs-reduced error comparison. This is not a git-history proof; no commit was made this round.
v0 approximate-tier thresholds (T_C/T_D/T_E/T_F) were null; v1 fills them with the engineering conventions declared in the execution prompt. The v0 files remain hash-frozen and unmodified.
No threshold may be relaxed after results are seen; any change requires a new, separately recorded, human-approved revision.

reference_solver.engine: MATLAB R2025b ode15s, author fMGG_synthesis.m RHS reused verbatim
reference_solver.grid: logspace(-4, 3, 200) (identical to the verified tight reference run)
reference_solver.tight_reference_evidence: runner reference mode reproduces results/pnas2017_reference/2026-09-25_aa_v1_reference_tight pointwise to <= 5.6e-10 trajectory-scaled (scratch-verified 2026-09-25)
reference_solver.tolerance_convergence: any acceptance quantity whose observed deviation between RelTol 1e-8 and 1e-10 exceeds 10% of its tier budget => NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED, not PASS/FAIL

error_formulas.S_y: max_t |y_full(t)| computed from the full (tight) reference ONLY
error_formulas.flux_scale_rule: instantaneous-flux errors are normalized by a declared production (or consumption) SCALE max_t(max(v_forward, v_reverse)), never by the near-zero net flux itself
error_formulas.cumulative_extent: xi_j(t) = integral_0^t v_j(tau) dtau of the GROSS directed author reaction rate v_j (never |v_net|); integrated as augmented DAE states inside the solver (no trapezoid on sparse samples as sole evidence)

T_A_exact_algebra_or_rewrite.states: arbitrary feasible states, not only the reference trajectory

applies_to: Python SBML-derived RHS vs author MATLAB full vector
generated pnas2017_aa_v1_rates vs SBML rate laws
A3a reduced vs full per-species trajectories (all 47 aminoacylation-relevant dynamic species incl. kept free MetAMP/GlyAMP)
activation / transfer / charging process fluxes v(t)
cumulative conversions: charging events, ATP->AMP+PPi consumption, AMP release, tRNA charging, fMGG output extent
epsilon = tau_fast/tau_slow over attracting modes only, structural/neutral modes excluded and listed
T_F_timescale_separation_screen.semantics: screen only; passing T_F never certifies QSSA without the attracting-manifold and moving-manifold evidence declared in the derivation

applies_to: enzyme family totals, tRNA families, adenine/phosphate moiety ledgers in every formal run
full network vs A1 pair-merged representation, same physics
(A1 was recorded as RHS-validated only in v0; the trajectory test becomes formal in v1)

numeric_uncertainty_budget: solver/representation uncertainty must be <= 10% of the tier budget for the comparison to be decidable; otherwise the verdict for that quantity is NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED

initial_layer_rules.capture: the dfinit consistent-initialization adjustment of every eliminated complex is recorded per run (initial_layer_jump); it is the numerical signature of the initial layer and is NEVER suppressed or projected away
initial_layer_rules.window: layer window = [t0, t0 + 5*tau_fast_local] using the derivation's tau_fast at the initial slow state
initial_layer_rules.scoring: T_C/T_D are reported over the full window AND over the post-layer window; a reduction that fails only inside the layer window is status APPROXIMATELY_VALIDATED_OUTSIDE_LAYER at most, with the layer as declared failure domain

initial_conditions_rule: both models start from identical physical inventories (same author initial values, same x0_scale per stress condition); no re-fit of the reduced initial layer

states: all enzyme-bound complexes (directly or via reconstruction)
observable_set_H_qualifier.particle_number_proxy: sum of all free+bound particle concentrations computed from declared species counts (no overlapping moiety double-count)
observable_set_H_qualifier.ionic_strength: NOT ASSESSABLE FROM CURRENT SOURCE DATA (never computed)

negative_software_test.procedure: copy fMGG_synthesis.m to a temp dir, corrupt one protected stoichiometric coefficient (change one react state index in one aminoacylation adenylation monomial), run the validator against the corrupted copy, and require it to REJECT

prohibitions: no silent projection onto conservation manifolds
